A notable open question in the area is to progress from oblivious to non- oblivious update time. That is: the update times in [43] and [34] hold with high probability against the randomness used in the algorithms, but only if the adversary choosing the graph updates is not allowed to see the random bits chosen by the algorithm. A non-oblivious construction would hold with high probability even if the adversary can base their updates on the random choices made by the construction.
